_comment: Temas de cosméticos (pedido do matheus em 19/10/2026): variar bastante, como no DDTank (surfista, piloto de avião, hip hop, espadachim, pirata, bobo da corte, chapéu fedora com óculos escuros, moletom com coroa...). Cada conjunto vira prompts do Codex com `node scripts/cosmetic-prompts.mjs --set=<id>` (--run gera). A arte segue SEMPRE o estilo das peças aprovadas anexadas; um tema muda roupa e acessórios, nunca o estilo de pintura, salvo pedido explícito.

sets.theme: hip hop de rua, estiloso e confiante

outfit.name: Rima de Rua
outfit.brief: an oversized street-style hip hop outfit: a big hoodie in saturated purple with a bold gold graffiti star print on the chest, the hood down behind the neck, a chunky gold chain with a round medallion, baggy black cargo joggers with side pockets, chunky white-and-purple high-top sneakers with fat laces, bare hands (skin #FCD0AC), one hand in the hoodie pocket, the other relaxed, cool laid-back stance
outfit.walkParts: big purple hoodie, gold chain with medallion, black cargo joggers, chunky high-top sneakers
outfit.details: a LONG oversized purple hoodie reaching the hips with its hood down behind the neck, ONE big gold graffiti STAR with paint drips on the chest (not zigzags), gold paint streaks running down both sleeves, a thick gold rope chain with a round gold medallion on the chest, dark charcoal-brown baggy cargo joggers with big side pockets, gold rings and straps, ribbed cuffs, chunky white-and-purple high-top sneakers with white laces

hair.name: Degradê Trançado
hair.brief: a male hip hop haircut: a short skin fade on the sides and nape that still comes down to the ear with a clear dark faded sideburn in front of the ear, and on top short twisted locs (small thick twists) pointing up and slightly back, black with dark violet highlights

hat.name: Boné Aba Reta
hat.brief: a hip hop snapback cap with a perfectly FLAT straight brim pointing forward-right, purple crown, black flat brim with a gold edge and a gold metallic star badge on the front, a small round sticker on the brim

glasses.name: Óculos Escuros Neon
glasses.brief: bold rectangular street sunglasses with a thick glossy black frame and gold corner studs, dark smoky violet lenses (semi-transparent so the eyes still show) with a neon pink-to-cyan reflection streak

outfit.name: Espadachim Errante
outfit.brief: a wandering swordsman outfit (samurai-inspired, original design): a teal haori jacket with white wave patterns at the hem worn over a white kimono, a dark indigo hakama (wide pleated trousers), a red sash tied at the waist with the knot on the side, white tabi socks with straw sandals, bare hands (skin #FCD0AC), one hand resting on the sash, the other relaxed. NO sword, no sheath, nothing in the hands
outfit.walkParts: teal haori with white wave hem, white kimono, red sash, indigo hakama, straw sandals
outfit.details: a LONG teal haori jacket reaching below the knees with wide sleeves, big white-and-cream wave patterns on the sleeves and on the lower hem, a cream inner lining, a white kimono with a crossed collar, a wide red sash tied at the waist with long hanging ends on the side, wide dark navy pleated hakama trousers down to the ankles with a thin gold wave line near the hem, white tabi socks and straw sandals

hair.name: Coque do Errante
hair.brief: a male swordsman hairstyle: hair swept back from the forehead into a SMALL compact topknot tied with a red cord on the back of the crown (the knot stays low, barely above the skull), the side hair coming down to the ear with a neat sideburn in front of the ear down to the middle of the ear, no locks on the forehead, the face completely free, deep navy black with blue highlights

hat.name: Chapéu de Palha Errante
hat.brief: a conical woven straw traveller's hat (kasa), worn on the head like a wide sun hat: a shallow cone with a small knob on top, visible woven texture, a red cord band around it and a small teal tassel hanging from the side, the brim an even wide ellipse around the head at brow height, seen from slightly above so only the top of the hat shows

hair.name: Corte Capitão
hair.brief: short, neat swept-back male cut with a confident side-swept quiff, a few sharp locks falling to the forehead on the right side (still above the eyebrows), short sides and nape, dark chestnut brown with warm copper highlights

outfit.name: Exploradora da Aurora
outfit.brief: a FEMININE starter adventurer outfit with a clearly female chibi body: narrow shoulders, slim arms, a defined small waist and soft hips, slimmer legs, small feet; a short cropped sapphire-blue travel jacket with gold trims and a coral lining, a white blouse with a small coral bow at the collar, a brown belt with a little map pouch, a pleated coral-and-cream skirt above the knee, white knee socks and brown ankle boots with gold buckles, bare hands (skin #FCD0AC), one hand lightly on the hip, the other relaxed; a graceful, cute and confident stance with the feet close together, knees slightly turned in. Same painting quality and detail as the approved outfits, but clearly a girl, not a boy
outfit.walkParts: short sapphire jacket with gold trims, white blouse with coral bow, brown belt with map pouch, pleated coral-and-cream skirt that swings with the step, white knee socks, brown ankle boots

outfit.name: Estrela Pop
outfit.brief: a cute pop idol stage dress: a pink and white dress with layered ruffled skirt above the knee, a big pink satin bow at the chest, small gold star sequins, short puffy sleeves, a lilac ribbon belt, white frilly gloves at the wrists, white knee-high boots with pink bows, one hand making a peace sign near the hip, the other on the waist, cheerful pose
outfit.walkParts: pink and white idol dress with ruffled skirt that bounces with the step, chest bow, puffy sleeves, white knee-high boots

hair.name: Maria-Chiquinha Estelar
hair.brief: long female twin tails (high pigtails on both sides of the head, the near one falling behind the shoulder), a short airy fringe above the eyebrows, glossy pastel pink with lilac highlights

hat.name: Laço de Palco
hat.brief: a big pink satin bow headband with a small gold star in the middle of the bow, sitting on top of the head slightly to the side, the thin band following the skull; it does NOT cover the hair or the forehead

glasses.name: Óculos Coração
glasses.brief: cute heart-shaped sunglasses with a glossy pink frame and soft pink tinted heart lenses

face.name: Brilho de Palco
face.brief: a FEMININE excited pop-star face: big sparkling eyes with long upper lashes and little star-shaped highlights, soft arched eyebrows, a wide happy open smile, light pink blush

outfit.name: Onda Tropical
outfit.brief: a female surfer beach outfit: a turquoise short-sleeve rash-guard crop top with white hibiscus prints and orange trims, light denim shorts with a white belt, a knotted orange sarong tied at the hip, a seashell bracelet, colorful flip-flop sandals, bare tanned-free legs (skin #FCD0AC), one hand on the hip, relaxed sunny pose
outfit.walkParts: turquoise rash-guard crop top with hibiscus, denim shorts, orange sarong that swings with the step, flip-flops

hair.name: Ondas de Praia
hair.brief: long loose beachy wavy female hair falling past the shoulders behind the ear, a side-swept fringe above the eyebrows, sun-kissed honey blonde with lighter golden streaks

hat.name: Viseira de Praia
hat.brief: a sporty sun visor: a white band around the head with a short curved turquoise brim at the front and a small orange hibiscus on the side; no crown, the hair on top stays visible

glasses.name: Óculos Sol Poente
glasses.brief: round retro sunglasses with a thin gold frame and gradient orange-to-pink tinted lenses

face.name: Sorriso de Verão
face.brief: a FEMININE relaxed sunny face: gentle half-closed happy eyes with long lashes, soft eyebrows, a sweet closed-mouth smile, a few light freckles on the cheeks

sets.theme: visual padrão do slot vazio (sem atributos, não é item): simples, poucos detalhes

outfit.name: Roupa Básica
outfit.brief: the plain default starter clothes of the game, with very few details: a plain white short-sleeve cotton t-shirt with a soft round collar, simple knee-length khaki-brown shorts with a thin dark-brown belt, white ankle socks and plain brown sneakers; clean and modest, no prints, no logos, no accessories, no pockets showing; relaxed friendly pose with one hand on the hip and the other raised in a small wave
outfit.walkParts: plain white short-sleeve t-shirt, khaki-brown knee-length shorts with thin belt, white socks and plain brown sneakers
outfit.details: plain white short-sleeve t-shirt with a soft round collar (no print); khaki-brown knee-length shorts; thin dark-brown belt; white ankle socks; plain brown sneakers

hair.name: Cabelo Básico
hair.brief: a simple short neat boy haircut in natural chestnut brown, a soft short fringe above the eyebrows, few strands, tidy and plain

face.name: Rosto Básico
face.brief: the plainest default face: simple round dark-brown eyes with one white highlight each, small calm eyebrows, a small relaxed closed-mouth smile, no blush, no special expression
